missing_evidence: Postgres server-side metrics: active/waiting connections, max_connections, and pool wait time for the order service
candidates.statement: Postgres connection pool exhaustion at the order service: save_order spans show pool size 5 with 0 idle connections and fail with DependencyUnavailable, causing order POST 503s, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502s on /v1/checkout.
candidates.uncertainty: No direct Postgres metrics; pool exhaustion inferred from span attributes (size 5, idle 0) and DependencyUnavailable errors.

report.explanation: Traces show every checkout failing at postgres.save_order with pool size 5/idle 0 and DependencyUnavailable, propagating to order 503, gateway ReadTimeout on /v1/orders, and 502 on /v1/checkout. Logs and metrics corroborate 502s and ~2s durations. Bounded candidate: db-pool-exhaustion.
